notes:
Context: small direct-to-consumer apparel brand, seasonal spikes (weekend sales, promo drops). Inbound lead from blog post on 'AI product Q&A for stores'. Mostly public-cloud friendly, wants self-serve hosted API.

Key pain: customers ask repetitive product questions (fit, materials, care). Current Zendesk macros are static; manually curating Q&A is heavy. Also poor search relevance when product titles vary. Wants one API to power chat widget + product detail automated FAQ.

Requirements / asks:
- Use-case: product Q&A widget (primary), catalog enrichment (auto-tagging, attributes), and search rerank (secondary).
- Latency expectation: p95 < 800ms for single-turn Q&A; happy with async enrichment at minutes granularity.
- Throughput: baseline ~15 reqs/sec, burst to 250 reqs/sec during sales windows (5-6 hour bursts).
- Cost sensitivity: high. Target $0.005-$0.02 per 1k tokens equivalent ROI threshold for experimentation phase.
- Models: prefer open/efficient models (quantized), can tolerate 8-bit variants. Not interested in hosted-proprietary models right now, wants transparent perf/cost.
- Routing: simple fallback desired (smaller cheaper model if cost rising).
- Data: will upload CSV of SKUs + description + size charts; wants hints on cleanup. No PII.
- Security: requires SOC2 attestation and SSO for admin console; audit logs desirable.

Quotes / customer language:
- "We need answers that don't sound like a generic product page — more practical, size-focused."
- "If the weekend sale breaks our widget, it's a big problem. Need graceful degradation."

POC plan (proposed):
1) Send API key and starter prompt templates (AE) - done
2) Customer uploads 2k SKU CSV and sample chat transcripts (ETA: 2026-03-01)
3) Run enrichment job (batch) to produce structured attributes + embeddings; measure token usage and latency
4) Spike test: simulate 5x traffic for 6 hours using hosted API with burst policy; monitor p95 and cost
5) Review results, optimize batching/kv-caching settings, propose monthly plan

Open items / blockers: billing approval from CFO (needs line item), CSV requires category normalization (SE to provide script), SAML config timeline unclear (security team needs 2 weeks).

Action items: AE to deliver test key and sample prompt set by 2026-02-28. SE to post cleanup script and sample infra note in Drive. Schedule spike test for first weekend in April (tentative).
notes_summary: Inbound SMB apparel D2C. Wants hosted API for product Q&A + enrichment. Cost-sensitive, expects weekend bursts. Trial + spike test planned. Blockers: billing signoff, CSV cleanup, SSO timeline.
